Vulnerabilities.Title: requests: Unintended leak of Proxy-Authorization header in redirects
Vulnerabilities.Description: Requests is an HTTP library. Requests forward Proxy-Authorization header during cross-origin redirects.

Vulnerabilities.Title: cryptography: NULL pointer dereference in PKCS12 parsing
Vulnerabilities.Description: A vulnerability in cryptography allows attackers to cause a denial of service via a crafted PKCS12 file.
